question: Which Indian institution collaborated with Inria Saclay in May 2025 to develop an AI tool aimed at combating antimicrobial resistance by identifying alternative antibiotics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIIT-Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IIIT-Delhi** collaborated with **Inria Saclay** in **May 2025** to develop an advanced **AI tool** aimed at addressing the critical global issue of antimicrobial resistance (AMR).
 
• The primary goal of this collaboration was to identify **alternative antibiotics** using artificial intelligence methodologies, thereby tackling the rising global health threat posed by drug-resistant bacteria.
 
• Antimicrobial resistance occurs when microbes, such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites, become resistant to the medications that once successfully treated them. This can make infections harder to treat and increase the risk of disease spread, severe illness, and death.
 
• The **AI tool** developed by IIIT-Delhi and Inria Saclay aims to analyze large datasets and use **machine learning algorithms** to predict potential alternative antibiotics by understanding bacterial resistance patterns.
 
• This collaboration signifies a step forward in leveraging cutting-edge technology and international partnership to combat pressing global health challenges.
 
• IIIT-Delhi is known for its excellence in research and development in the field of information technology and computer science, making it a strong partner in this initiative.
 
• **Inria Saclay** is a renowned French research institute specializing in computer science and automation, known for its expertise in developing innovative technological solutions, including artificial intelligence.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About IIIT-Delhi:**

 
 
• The **Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi (IIIT-Delhi)**, established in **2008**, is a leading institute in India dedicated to research and education in IT and allied fields.
 
• Located in **New Delhi, India**, the institute offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in computer science and engineering, electronics, and communication engineering, and other related fields.
 
• IIIT-Delhi has been at the forefront of innovative research in areas such as **artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, and computational biology**.
 
 
 
• **About Inria Saclay:**
 
 
• **Inria Saclay** is one of the research centers of the **French National Institute for Research in Computer Science and Automation**.
 
• The institute focuses on the development of core technologies in the fields of **AI, machine learning, robotics, and high-performance computing**.
 
• Inria has a strong history of international collaboration and has been instrumental in driving technological innovations in Europe.
 
 
 
• **Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR):**
 
 
• **AMR** is a global health threat that occurs when microorganisms evolve to resist the effects of antimicrobial drugs, such as antibiotics.
 
• It is estimated that by **2050**, AMR could cause up to **10 million deaths annually** if not addressed effectively.
 
• AI and machine learning offer promising solutions to tackle AMR by enabling the discovery of new antibiotics and predicting resistance patterns in microbes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of AI in Combating AMR:**

 
 
• AI can analyze large-scale datasets and identify patterns that may not be evident through traditional research methods.
 
• Machine learning models can predict the effectiveness of existing antibiotics and suggest combinations or alternatives to combat resistant strains.
 
• The use of AI has already led to the discovery of a new antibiotic, **Halicin**, which was identified using machine learning algorithms in **2020**.
 
 
 
• **Global Collaboration in Research:**
 
 
• Partnerships like the one between **IIIT-Delhi** and **Inria Saclay** highlight the importance of international cooperation in solving global challenges.
 
• Such collaborations enable the sharing of expertise, resources, and technology to accelerate research and innovation.
